title: Tool Use
description: 分镜与终端离线剧本相同：一轮写出 .tmp/s02/ 两个文件 → 一轮补丁（一份落地、一份因上下文对不上被整体拒绝）→ 核对。终端不读你的提示词；这里也不是在跑 code.ts。 / Same storyboard as the terminal offline demo: write two files under .tmp/s02/, then two patches (one commits, one is rejected wholesale), then verify. The script ignores your prompt; this player is not live code.ts.

steps.content: Create two files a.md and b.md, then list the directory
steps.annotation: User sends a task. Offline mode ignores the text and plays a fixed script.

steps.content: turn 1: 3 function_call items in one output — fan-out
steps.annotation: One Responses output can hold several function_call items. The harness dispatches each by name.
Structured write — no echo > quoting. Path is a typed argument.
Second call in the same turn — same name, different path
Dispatch map routes by name; the loop does not special-case the second write
shell stays as the escape hatch, no longer the only tool
Results are fed back as function_call_output; the loop continues

steps.content: turn 2: 4 function_call items in one output — apply_patch ×2 / read_file / list_dir
steps.annotation: The model still has not stopped. Another fan-out, now including apply_patch.

steps.content:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: .tmp/s02/alpha.md
@@
 # Alpha
+
+Patched by apply_patch.
*** Add File: .tmp/s02/usage.md
+# Usage
*** End Patch
steps.annotation: Real Codex patch grammar: @@-anchored update + Add File, committed atomically
Whole patch parsed and validated before a single byte is written

steps.content:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: .tmp/s02/alpha.md
@@
 this line is not in the file
-# Alpha
+# ALPHA
*** End Patch
steps.annotation: Context does not match the file — the harness must reject the whole patch
Atomic failure: nothing is written. The file stays as the first patch left it.
Verify the failed patch did not half-write the file
alpha.md is intact — still the first patch, not ALPHA
Structured listing — no parsing of free-text ls output
usage.md exists from the first patch; the second patch added nothing

steps.content: Done. Two files were written under .tmp/s02/, the first patch updated alpha.md and added usage.md, and the second patch was rejected wholesale because its context did not match. That is why Codex prefers a structured patch: reviewable, atomic, and it fails cleanly.
steps.annotation: No function_call items → loop stops. Same ending as the terminal offline script.
